title: Kessler Owner Rewards Gold and Platinum Estimate Tolerance by Account Age — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account at Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum, the estimate tolerance of an authorized concern line — the share by which the line's customer-pay labor and parts may exceed the authorized amount before anything is credited back — follows how long the account had been open when the line closed.

| Tier | Whole months from the account's opening date to the day the line's labor closed | Estimate tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| Gold or Platinum | 24 or more | 5% |
| Gold or Platinum | fewer than 24 | 7.5% |
| Any other tier | any | the tier's estimate overage tolerance; no such change applies |

**Terms.** The day the line's labor closed is the latest line date of that concern line's labor charges. Whole months are counted from one date to another, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Edges (hypothetical dates).**
- Gold account opened 9 May; line closed 9 May two years later: 24 whole months, tolerance 5%. Closed 8 May two years later: 23 whole months, tolerance 7.5%.
- Account opened 31 March: the first whole month is not complete on 30 April; it completes on 1 May.

**Applied (hypothetical).** On a Platinum line authorized at 600.00 with 30 whole months of account age, the line may be billed up to 630.00 before anything is credited back; with 11 whole months, up to 645.00.
